rackingModuleBondingRequirement.method: Roof Tech RT-MINI listed mounting assembly bonding path (UL 2703) — module frames + racking
rackingModuleBondingRequirement.codeBasis: NEC 690.43 / 250.136 (equipment bonding of module frames + racking) — evaluated on its OWN authority
rackingModuleBondingRequirement.verificationNote: The module-frame / racking bonding requirement is independent of the open-air cable-grounding question and is NOT resolved by this authority; its own listed-assembly verification governs (see the racking assembly authority).

authority.pathBasis: Σ per-branch BranchCablePath (same designed-installed geometry as the trunk)
authority.explanation: The equipment grounding / bonding method for the open-air microinverter branch (cable-assembly) section is NOT ESTABLISHED. No manufacturer document in this repository states the method for the exact selected equipment, so NEITHER outcome may be asserted — not an additional grounding conductor, and not a listed no-additional-conductor method. Any conductor quantity shown for this section is a PROPOSED / DESIGN QUANTITY only (QCABLE-GROUNDING-AUTHORITY-UNVERIFIED; see RS-1). This is a fail-closed state, not a finding.
authority.resolutionRequirement: Archive and verify, through the document registry, the manufacturer installation document that EXPLICITLY states the equipment grounding / bonding method for the open-air branch section of the EXACT selected equipment (microinverter SKU + cable-assembly SKU + module SKU + mounting/bonding system) in this project jurisdiction: record its SHA-256, revision, current status, the exact section/page carrying the statement, and its own declared exact-SKU applicability. A family / series / product-line document (an IQ8 family datasheet, IQ-Commercial QD-Cable guidance, a legacy Engage rule), a conductor-count inference, or an engineering opinion can never clear this.

groundingDomainGraph.label: Open-air microinverter branch (listed cable assembly) — GROUNDING METHOD: PENDING MANUFACTURER AUTHORITY
groundingDomainGraph.basis: NEC 110.3(B) — the listing + manufacturer instructions for the EXACT selected microinverter and cable assembly decide whether an additional equipment grounding conductor is installed in this section.
groundingDomainGraph.independenceNote: This is the ONLY domain the open-air grounding resolver governs.

groundingDomainGraph.label: Equipment grounding conductor inside the shared home-run raceway (PVC Sch 80 1-1/4") — #12 AWG
groundingDomainGraph.basis: INDEPENDENTLY REQUIRED per NEC 250.118 / 250.122 with sizing from the branch OCPD: these are FIELD-INSTALLED conductors in a raceway (THWN-2 in PVC), i.e. in-raceway wiring-method territory. A wiring-method EGC is required with the circuit conductors and its basis has NOTHING to do with the double-insulation / listed-assembly question that governs the open-air cable section. Retained under every open-air outcome.
groundingDomainGraph.independenceNote: NOT affected by the open-air grounding outcome — a raceway wiring method needs its own EGC regardless.

groundingDomainGraph.label: Module-frame + racking bonding — Roof Tech RT-MINI listed mounting assembly bonding path (UL 2703) — module frames + racking
groundingDomainGraph.basis: NEC 690.43 / 250.136 (equipment bonding of module frames + racking) — evaluated on its OWN authority
groundingDomainGraph.independenceNote: The module-frame / racking bonding requirement is independent of the open-air cable-grounding question and is NOT resolved by this authority; its own listed-assembly verification governs (see the racking assembly authority).

groundingDomainGraph.label: Grounding electrode conductor (GEC)
groundingDomainGraph.basis: NEC 250.64 / 690.47 — interconnected system bonds to the existing GES; no separate GEC added
groundingDomainGraph.independenceNote: Electrode-system domain — unrelated to equipment grounding of the array branch circuits.

groundingDomainGraph.label: Service / enclosure bonding at the point of interconnection
groundingDomainGraph.basis: NEC 250.24 / 250.92 / 690.47 — the interconnected equipment enclosures and the existing service bonding means; evaluated on the service topology objects, not on any array-side grounding question.
groundingDomainGraph.independenceNote: Service-side domain — never inherits an array-side grounding outcome.
